title: Palia
shortDescription: Discover a welcoming world in Palia, a free-to-play fantasy life sim adventure where you can craft, explore, and create the life and home of your dreams. With nearly endless ways to make Palia your home, you’ll find relaxation and joy in every corner of this vibrant, heartwarming world.
zhShortDescription: 免费 MMO 生活模拟，建造家园、耕种捕鱼。
description: Welcome to Palia, The Fantasy Life Sim Adventure For You and Your Friends! Discover a welcoming world in Palia, a free-to-play fantasy life sim adventure where you can craft, explore, and create the life and home of your dreams. With nearly endless ways to make Palia your home, you’ll find relaxation and joy in every corner of this vibrant, heartwarming world. Live Your Fantasy Dream Life Dive into a world rich with adventure and lore. Complete quests that reveal the secrets of Ancient Humans, deepen your connections with Palia’s Villagers, raise adorable animal companions on your Ranch, and help shape the story around you. Craft, Build, and Make Memories Together Design your ideal space with near limitless possibilities! Craft items, place Building Blocks, and landscape with Yardwork Deco
zhDescription: 《Palia》是免费多人在线生活模拟游戏。建造装饰家园、耕种作物、钓鱼捕虫、狩猎采矿。强调合作而非竞争——和全球玩家一起探索冒险。画面温馨精致。
metaDescriptionEn: Palia review — cozy free-to-play MMO. Home building, skill progression, community events.
metaDescriptionZh: 《帕里亚》Steam 评测与介绍 — 治愈系免费 MMO。家园建造、技能升级、社区活动。

topReviews.review:
Imagine grinding through every quest the game has to offer, finally earning a rare black horse with a flaming mane as a reward for your dedication… and then the developers turn around and say: “Nice horse, mind coughing up €25 if you actually want to ride it?”

That’s honestly what Palia’s monetization feels like right now.

Cosmetic cash shops are one thing, but locking features or meaningful rewards behind absurd pricing after players already earned them through gameplay just feels insulting. It completely kills the sense of achievement.

topReviews.zh_review: 想象一下：肝完所有任务终于获得稀有黑马奖励……然后开发者说'马不错，想骑再交25欧元？'外观商城是一回事，但把玩家通过游戏获得的奖励锁在离谱付费墙后面简直侮辱人。编辑：开发者好像听进去了。

topReviews.review:
Mixed feelings on it. I started playing in the alpha days and recently came back, there are lots of things to like about the game but a few things hold it back from being ultimately a game I can just dive super deep into.

Likes:
• Very charming aesthetic and presentation. The graphics are simple like WoW/Dreamlight, the music is great, it's just a pleasant world to be in.
• Lots of things to do, you don't have to stick to one hobby or activity at any time.
• Many quests to do with varying levels of interesting lore going on.

Dislikes:
• Lots of information/quest guidance is just not shown yo…
topReviews.zh_review: 感觉复杂。从alpha时期开始玩，最近回来了。魅力十足的美学和呈现，画面简洁，音乐很棒。太多事情可做。很多任务和有趣剧情。但大量信息/任务引导不够，很多事情不清楚。

topReviews.review:
Провела в игре порядочно времени, привела друзей, чтобы играть вместе, участвовала в активностях, взаимодействовала с другими игроками - и теперь всё, подключиться нельзя из-за ограничения по стране. Очень круто, конечно. 
Для игры, которая во многом говорит о возможностях, о терпении, учит коммуникации, такое решение лицемерно. 
Крайне осуждаю.
topReviews.zh_review: 花了很多时间、拉朋友一起玩、参与各种活动——然后地区限制连不上去了。对于一款大谈可能性、耐心、教人交流的游戏，这种决定太虚伪了。极度谴责。

topReviews.review:
I have mixed feelings when it comes to Palia; I wish there was a neutral button for this one. I've been playing since closed beta, way before it was available on Steam, so I have hundreds of hours played beyond these 500h. I played on multiple accounts but Steam only allows you to link one, so keep that in mind. You can only create one character per account.

I was really excited to get a "cozy MMO" that could give me a break from Warcraft. I spent a decent amount of time playing and participating in communities in the last -almost- 3 years and I dropped a decent amount of money in the cash sh…
topReviews.zh_review: 对Palia感情复杂。从封闭beta就开始玩了，远超这500小时。曾期待一个休闲MMO能从魔兽世界喘口气。近3年花了大量时间在社区和商城。但内容更新太慢，bug永远修不完。

topReviews.review: I would rather they put a price on the game and get rid of the microtransactions. This game was fun in the beginning, and I played it constantly, but now anytime I log in, it's just a eye roll at all the things I "could" buy with real money.
topReviews.zh_review: 我宁愿他们定个价然后取消微交易。一开始很好玩，但现在每次登录看到可以花钱买的东西就翻白眼。
